name: Open-Archiver
description: A secure, sovereign, and open-source platform for email archiving and eDiscovery. Open Archiver provides a robust, self-hosted solution for archiving, storing, indexing, and searching emails from major platforms, including Google Workspace (Gmail), Microsoft 365, PST files, as well as generic IMAP-enabled email inboxes. Use Open Archiver to keep a permanent, tamper-proof record of your communication history, free from vendor lock-in.

ports.name: WebUI-Port
ports.description: WebUI-Port, set this the same as PORT_FRONTEND

variables.name: SYNC_FREQUENCY
variables.description: The frequency of continuous email syncing. Default is every minutes, but you can change it to another value based on your needs.

variables.name: STORAGE_TYPE
variables.description: Choose your storage backend. Valid options are 'local' or 's3'.

variables.name: STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT_PATH
variables.description: The path inside the container where files will be stored. This is mapped to a Docker volume for persistence. This is only used if STORAGE_TYPE is 'local'.

variables.name: STORAGE_S3_ENDPOINT
variables.description: These are only used if STORAGE_TYPE is 's3'.

variables.name: STORAGE_S3_BUCKET
variables.description: These are only used if STORAGE_TYPE is 's3'.

variables.name: STORAGE_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
variables.description: These are only used if STORAGE_TYPE is 's3'.

variables.name: STORAGE_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
variables.description: These are only used if STORAGE_TYPE is 's3'.

variables.name: STORAGE_S3_REGION
variables.description: These are only used if STORAGE_TYPE is 's3'.

variables.name: STORAGE_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE
variables.description: Set to 'true' for MinIO and other non-AWS S3 services

variables.name: RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS
variables.description: The window in milliseconds for which API requests are checked. Defaults to 60000 (1 minute).

variables.name: RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS
variables.description: The maximum number of API requests allowed from an IP within the window. Defaults to 100.

variables.name: JWT_SECRET
variables.description: IMPORTANT: Change this to a long, random, and secret string.

variables.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.description: IMPORTANT: Generate a secure, random 32-byte hex string for this. You can use `openssl rand -hex 32` to generate a key.
